model: REACT damper / VAV actuator (Modbus RTU, 2018 sheet)
equipment_type: Actuator / valve (ventilation damper and VAV actuator)
applies_to: Swegon REACT demand-controlled-ventilation dampers with the Modbus actuators named in the sheet (309C-024-150-MB/SL8/ST15/SWE, 227VM-024-**-MB/SWE), sheet dated 2018-11-08.
summary: Swegon's REACT dampers for demand-controlled ventilation can be fitted with a Modbus RTU actuator. All points are holding registers read with function 03 and written one at a time with 06: set point, override and command, actuator type, relative and absolute position and flow, an optional analog output, flow limits, bus-failure action, set point source mode, Modbus address and flow unit.

addressing.note: The sheet prints a decimal 'Address' starting at 0 (Set point). Use the printed number as the wire address.

source.title: REACT Modbus
source.pages: p. 1 (protocol, functions), p. 2 (customer holding registers), p. 3 (service values), p. 4 (customer values, communication setting table)

notes: This is the REACT sheet for the actuators named above; the REACT Parasol Zenith with Belimo actuator has its own map in the library.

Factory communication setting differs by actuator: page 1 and footnote 4 give setting 14 (19200 baud, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit) for the 227VM-024-**-MB/SWE, while footnote 1 marks setting 24 (38400 baud, no parity, 1 stop bit) as the default for the 309C-024-150-MB/SL8/ST15/SWE. Settings 1-24 are listed in the sheet. Default slave address is not stated.
Only function codes 03 and 06 are implemented. The sheet notes settings 1-3 and 19 limit a read to 8 registers.
Command values 0, 2 and 3 and Device ID 0 are printed as '- - -' (unused).
All values are 16-bit WORD; the protocol line mentions floats but none are listed.

registers.name: Set point
registers.description: Damper / flow set point, 0-10000 = 0-100 %. Read-only when register 122 = 0.

registers.name: Absolute flow
registers.description: VAV flow in m³/h or l/s (unit per register 201).

registers.name: Analog output
registers.description: Optional analog output, 0-10000 mV; see register 122.

registers.name: Bus fail position
registers.description: Action on loss of bus (120 s timeout).

registers.name: Min value absolute
registers.description: Minimum flow in m³/h or l/s.

registers.name: Max value absolute
registers.description: Maximum flow in m³/h or l/s.

registers.name: Mode signal set point analog output
registers.description: Where the set point comes from and what the analog output shows.

values.0: Set point from analog in 1; output = absolute position
values.1: Set point via Modbus register 0; output = absolute position
values.2: Register 0 scaled min-max flow; output = register 10
values.3: Set point from analog in 1; output = register 10

integration.summary: Set register 122 to 1 (or 2) so the set point comes from Modbus, then write the set point to register 0 and read relative position (4) and flow (6/7).
integration.enable: Register 122 Mode: 1 = set point via Modbus register 0 (0 = analog input, then register 0 is read-only).
integration.watchdog: Bus fail position (108): 1 closes, 2 opens the damper when no bus traffic for 120 s; 0 disables monitoring.
quirks: Set point, relative position and relative flow use 0-10000 for 0-100 %.
65535 in position registers means the function is not supported.
setup: Default serial setting depends on the actuator (19200 8E1 for 227VM, 38400 8N1 for 309C); 120 ohm termination is external.
A response delay can be set in 3 ms steps for slow masters.
gotchas: Flow units (l/s or m³/h) follow register 201.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
